title: Legacy 'Parts Tech / Parts Technician' users become 'Parts Technician' after migration
preconds:
1. Migration to the new roles is complete.
  2. At least one existing 'Parts Tech / Parts Technician' user is present.
steps:
1. Go to Settings > Staff and find a 'Parts Tech / Parts Technician' user.
  2. Check the user's assigned role.
  3. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions and find that role's row.
  4. Look at the role's read-only Permission Summary (eye icon).
expected:
The user's role is 'Parts Technician'.

The role's permissions match the expected set for that role.

The 'Parts Technician' role is editable (it has a pencil icon).
